error.optimize:range: The optimizer found no plan in the range of the ephemeris data. The plan did not change.

tisserand.x: Periapsis radius of the orbit about the Sun (au)
tisserand.label: Tisserand graph of the plan
tisserand.caption: Thin curves: constant v∞ at each planet (1 km/s to 15 km/s), for circular planet orbits in one plane. Thick curves: the v∞ of the plan in km/s ({speeds}). A flyby with no engine burn moves the orbit along a curve of that planet. Points: the orbit of each leg. A triangle shows an open orbit.

tour.title: Flyby tour
tour.intro: The plan is a sequence of bodies and dates. The application calculates each leg as a two-body orbit about the Sun and each flyby as a hyperbola about the body.
tour.noMission: No mission is open. Make a new mission, or open a mission on the Mission screen.
tour.noPlan: This mission has a flight but no plan. A flight from a file or from a state vector has no plan.
tour.sequence: Sequence of bodies and dates, with the flybys
tour.freeHint: The optimizer can change a free date.
tour.minAltitudeOf: Minimum flyby altitude at body number {n}
tour.insert: Add a body after this body
tour.insertAfter: Add a body after body number {n}
tour.sequenceNote: The first body is the departure body. The last body is the target. The bodies between them are flybys. The optimizer can change the dates that are free. A yellow altitude is at the minimum flyby altitude.
tour.legNote: A deep-space maneuver is one engine burn between two encounters. When you add one, the optimizer finds its direction and its magnitude.
tour.soiTime: The dates are periapsis dates (time correction for the sphere of influence)
tour.poweredNote: One or more flybys need an engine burn: the body cannot give the necessary turn above the minimum altitude, or the speeds before and after the flyby are different. Change the dates or use the optimizer.
tour.moons: Flight calculation: large moons are separate masses
tour.optimizeDsm: Flight calculation: optimize the flyby before each deep-space maneuver (slower)
tour.calculateNote: The flight calculation converts the plan to a trajectory in the full force model. It adds small correction maneuvers that keep each flyby on its aim point.
tour.objective: Quantity to make as small as possible

objectives.c3: Departure v∞ and Δv in flight
objectives.arrival: Arrival v∞ and Δv before the arrival

tour.global: Global search (slower, finds other launch windows)
tour.range: Search range for each free date (±)
tour.optimizerNote: The local search (Nelder-Mead method) starts from the plan that you see. The global search (differential evolution) examines many dates in the search range first.
tour.encounterNote: B·T and B·R are the aim point in the B-plane. The T axis is in the ecliptic plane.
